periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Ran winter flu and COVID clinics at library branches and senior housing, giving 540 doses. Partners: Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Housing Authority.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold spring catch-up clinics and plan back-to-school immunization clinics.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Spring catch-up clinics drew low turnout once respiratory season ended, and doses rose only to 610. Scheduled back-to-school clinics at four schools and arranged a mobile visit to the airport. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Housing Authority.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run back-to-school clinics at four schools, take mobile vaccination to the airport staff lounge, and begin scheduling fall flu clinics.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Offered back-to-school immunization clinics at four schools and began scheduling fall flu and COVID clinics at libraries and senior housing. Mobile vaccination reached the airport staff lounge. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Housing Authority.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold 12 flu clinics between October and December, and send reminders for the second doses.
